lines.text: By warfare and exile the LORD contended with Israel and removed her with a fierce wind, as on the day the north wind blows.
Jacob's guilt will be atoned for, and the full fruit of removing his sin is that he makes all the altar stones like crushed chalk.
Israelites will be gathered one by one, and those perishing in Assyria and the exiles in Egypt will worship the LORD on Mount Sinai.
